title: Learning to Reason with Predictive Gains for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21441v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning-enhanced generative recommendation (GR) has attracted increasing attention for leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to improve next-item prediction. However, existing methods primarily optimize reasoning through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rule-based rewards determined by final recommendation performance, which faces two key limitations: (i) unmeasured predictive contributions within reasoning, where the predictive contributions of individual reasoning steps are not directly reflected in optimization signals, and (ii) weakly discriminative learning signals within groups, where different reasoning trajectories within the group often receive indistinguishable rewards, limiting effective policy optimization. translated_title: 基于预测增益学习推理的生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 推理增强的生成式推荐（GR）因利用大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力来改进下一项预测而受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有方法主要通过群体相对策略优化（GRPO）来优化推理，其奖励是由最终推荐性能决定的基于规则的奖励，这面临两个关键局限：（i）推理中的预测贡献未被衡量，即各个推理步骤的预测贡献没有直接体现在优化信号中；（ii）群体内学习信号区分度弱，即群体内不同的推理轨迹往往获得难以区分的奖励，限制了有效的策略优化。在本文中，我们提出 GainReason，一个简单而有效的训练框架，通过预测增益来优化推理。具体而言，PG 衡量……的变化（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 GainReason 训练框架，通过引入预测增益来衡量每个推理步骤对下一项预测的贡献，从而解决现有基于 GRPO 的推理增强生成式推荐中预测贡献未被衡量、群体内奖励区分度弱的问题。
en_tdlr: GainReason is a training framework that optimizes reasoning for generative recommendation via Predictive Gain, measuring the predictive contribution of each reasoning step to overcome the unmeasured contributions and weakly discriminative group rewards of standard GRPO-based methods.
